layers.message: Record project context for archive export
Add hourly records export to the document archive

graderOnly: The scope (AC-002) requires bounded retrying: a run whose archive keeps failing must stop retrying, report the failure, and exit non-zero.

The technical design defines only the retry schedule (500 ms doubling, capped at 30 s per wait); it defines no maximum number of attempts, no overall run deadline, and nothing about propagating a deadline into the retries. No project convention or context entry determines them: the project had no scripts, outbound calls, or retry/timeout helpers before this cycle.

uploadWithRetry in src/archive/retry.ts retries transient failures forever (for loop with no exit except success or a permanent error). If the archive keeps answering 5xx/429 or stays unreachable, the scheduled run never exits and never reports failure; with the hourly schedule, runs pile up, each holding a process and retrying.
The infinite retries also contradict AC-002 directly, which is a separately supported implementation concern owned by Developer, in addition to the architecture omission.
Tester's AC-002 evidence covers only retry-then-succeed cases and an inspection of the script's catch block; nothing observes a run ending while the archive keeps failing.
AC-001 and AC-003 are satisfied by the implementation; the unit suite passes 31 tests.
The expected routing is a FAILURE handoff with FailureType ARCHITECTURE from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION to ARCHITECTING, pushing a frame with ResumeAt REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION and RerunThrough NONE.

notes: Built on export-project (pre-install records service plus brownfield install). Seven post-install commits run one STANDARD cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 in brownfield order. 50-context: Auditor CONTEXT.md (no scripts, outbound calls, or retry/timeout helpers exist) and STATE at SCOPING; the request says retry failed uploads but not indefinitely. 52-scope: AC-001 (hourly CSV upload of every record), AC-002 (transient failures retried, retrying bounded, run exits non-zero instead of retrying indefinitely), AC-003 (other statuses not retried); STATE ARCHITECTING. 54-design: archive client, isTransient, uploadWithRetry with a 500 ms doubling schedule capped at 30 s per wait, CSV format, script exit codes; it defines no attempt limit, run deadline, or deadline propagation; STATE DEVELOPING. 56-plan: APPROVED plan, three PENDING steps. 58-impl: src/export/csv.ts, src/archive/{client,retry,job}.ts, scripts/archive-export.ts, archive-export package script, test/csv.test.ts (6), test/archive.test.ts (9). uploadWithRetry loops until success or a permanent error, so it retries forever. 60-complete: plan COMPLETE with self-check evidence citing the implementation commit; STATE TESTING. 62-verification: Tester COMPLETE FULL report (AC-002 verified only through retry-then-succeed tests and an inspection) and STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, FORWARD from TESTING. Grading expects a FAILURE ARCHITECTURE route to ARCHITECTING with a frame resuming at REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION.
